name: Publish to Microsoft Skills

  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'skills/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-to-microsoft-skills.yml'

jobs:
  publish-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Get changed files
        id: get-changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: skills/**

      - name: Validate skill files
        if: steps.get-changed-files.outputs.added_modified != ''
        run: |
          echo "Validating changed skill files..."
          # Add validation logic here if needed
          echo "Validation completed"

      - name: Build skills
        if: steps.get-changed-files.outputs.added_modified != ''
        run: |
          echo "Building skills..."
          # Add build commands here if needed
          echo "Build completed"

      - name: Deploy skills to Microsoft Skills
        if: steps.get-changed-files.outputs.added_modified != ''

          AZURE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}

          AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

        run: |
          echo "Deploying skills to Microsoft Skills..."
